pages.heading: Straddler
pages.body: Basalt Deltas. Hostile relative of the Strider that launches Stradpoles. Rare Straddlite drops make a Straddleboard. The board travels over lava but sinks in water

pages.heading: Straddler (cont.)
pages.body: and can fail after a hard collision. Carry fire protection and leave room to turn.
